meta.title: Motif
meta.description: Open-source market of UI components, motion effects, shaders and agent skills. Generate and tune them with an agent, then take the code or skill home.

home.headline: Beautiful motion, ready to take home
home.lead: Components, motion and shaders picked from open source. Tune them live and take the code, or let your agent shop for them over MCP.
home.howTitle: Pick one, tune it, take it home

pick.title: Pick an effect
pick.body: Every effect comes from an open-source project whose license allows redistribution, with a live preview and its source, license and changes on record.

tune.title: Tune it until it’s right
tune.body: Every parameter has a range tightened so any value looks good. Presets give you genuinely different looks, and a link shares your values.

take.title: Take the code or the skill
take.body: Download a runnable Vite project, install into an existing app with shadcn, or download the skill so Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can build the same effect in your project.

home.sourcesBody: Integrated code keeps its original license and copyright notices, pinned to the commits we reviewed. Thank you to their authors.
home.levelsTitle: From a whole site to a single button
home.levelsLead: Templates, styles, sections, components and effects: from an entire website down to one loading animation, everything can be previewed, tuned, downloaded, or copied as a skill.

agents.title: Let agents do the shopping
agents.lead: Over MCP, agents such as Claude Code and Cursor search the catalogue, look at previews and fetch code with the values they want. When nothing fits, they place a custom order and the Studio agent builds it.
agents.query: pricing card with a glowing border

studio.title: Describe it, get it built
studio.body: Tell Studio what you want in a sentence; the agent writes the component and tunes it.

community.title: Submit your work
community.body: Approved work joins the market, with credit and provenance on chain.

market.title: Market
market.lead: {count} items, all from open source you are allowed to reuse. Preview and tune them live, then take the code or the skill.

reward.title: Reward
reward.body: Approved work earns MOTIF and reputation, and again when someone remixes it.

submit.title: Submit
submit.lead: Upload an item file. The site checks it and shows a live preview; then post the bond and submit.
submit.notJson: That is not a valid JSON file.
submit.drop: Drop a .motif.json, or click to choose
submit.dropHint: One file holds the manifest and every source file
submit.failed: {count, plural, one {# problem to fix} other {# problems to fix}}
submit.parentMissing: provenance.basedOn points to “{slug}”, which is not on chain or has no approved version
submit.hashMismatch: The content hash computed in your browser differs from the check result. Choose the file again.

panel.title: Submit
panel.asNew: This will be submitted for review as a new item.
panel.asVersion: You maintain this item; this will be submitted for review as version {version}.
panel.lowBalance: Your balance does not cover the bond.
panel.steps: Your wallet asks, in order: sign the upload → approve the bond (first time only) → send the submission.

blocked.taken: This slug is already used by {maintainer}. Pick another slug.
blocked.pending: The previous version of this item is still in review. Submit a new version after it closes.
blocked.delisted: This item has been delisted and cannot take new versions.

remix.lead: Remix “{title}”: download the source, restore it with pnpm item:unpack, change it, and set provenance.basedOn to {slug}.

prepare.title: Prepare an item file with the CLI
prepare.scratch: From scratch: create an item folder under packages/registry/items/, then run pnpm item:pack my-effect.
prepare.remix: Remix a built-in item: pnpm item:remix mesh-gradient my-gradient copies it with its provenance; pack it when done.
prepare.community: Remix a community work: download its source from the item page and restore it with pnpm item:unpack my-effect.motif.json.

criteria.title: Review criteria
criteria.quality: The defaults look great, and nothing in the tuning ranges looks bad.
criteria.license: Real provenance, a redistributable license and the original copyright headers. Original work is MIT.
criteria.motion: Handles reduced motion, pauses off screen, never slows the page.
criteria.network: Loads nothing from external CDNs, fonts or analytics, and sends no data out.

submit.fromStudio: No item file? <link>Make one in the Studio</link> and submit it from there.

item.sourceWithheld: The item is delisted; its source is no longer served.
item.sourceMissing: The site does not have the source for this version (the author may not have uploaded it).
item.verifyHint: its sha256(JCS) should equal the content hash above

review.title: Review of v{version}
review.genesis: Imported at genesis: reviewed by the maintainers before it went on chain, so there is no community review.
review.noteMissing: (the full note is not on this site)

actions.title: Actions
actions.none: There is nothing you can do on this item.

maintainer.lead: You maintain this item and can submit a new version.

vote.conflicted: You submitted this or wrote the remixed version, so you sit this review out.
vote.lead: Judge it against the review criteria. Whichever side reaches the quorum first decides the outcome.
vote.label: Verdict

hints.approve: It looks good, its ranges are sensible, and its provenance and license hold up. The author gets the bond back plus the reward.
hints.reject: Not good enough yet, or it has problems to fix. The bond goes back to the author so they can improve it and resubmit.
hints.violation: Plagiarism, a fake license, malicious code or spam. When violations outnumber rejections the bond is forfeited and reputation is deducted.

vote.notePlaceholder: Explain your reasoning (required for reject and violation). The site hosts the note; the chain records its hash.
vote.noteRequired: Reject and violation need a reason.

withdraw.lead: No curator has voted yet, so you can withdraw this submission and get the bond back.

expire.lead: The review period is over without a decision. Anyone can close it; the bond goes back to the submitter.

accept.lead: The maintainer wants to hand this item to you. Once you accept, you submit its future versions.

transfer.title: Transfer maintainership
transfer.lead: Hand it to another address; it takes effect once they accept.
transfer.pending: Waiting for {address} to accept. Submit again to pick someone else.

moderate.label: Moderator
moderate.delistLead: Delist {slug}: it disappears from the market and the site stops serving its source. History and attribution stay on chain.

review.title: Review
review.lead: A submission settles once {quorum} curators agree. Reviews run for {days} days.
review.howCurators: Curators are appointed by governance vote. Each vote earns reputation.
review.nothingForYou: Nothing is waiting for your review.

moderate.label: Moderator
moderate.lead: Clear @{handle}'s profile and block the handle (impersonation, infringement, illegal content). The account and its reputation stay.

profileEditor.title: Creator profile
profileEditor.lead: Your handle is your on-chain name in the community; the rest of your profile is hosted by the site.
profileEditor.handleHint: 3–32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens. If you rename, the old handle stays yours.
profileEditor.handleChangeHint: You can rename; the old handle stays yours.
profileEditor.handleRule: Use 3–32 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen.
profileEditor.name: Display name
profileEditor.linksHint: One per line, up to {max}, starting with http:// or https://.
profileEditor.publicNote: Profiles are public: the on-chain record is permanent, and the hosted profile can be updated at any time.

governance.title: Governance
governance.lead: Delegate your MOTIF votes to make and decide proposals. Passed proposals run after a timelock.

delegation.title: My voting power
delegation.lead: MOTIF counts as votes once delegated, which can be to yourself. Your tokens stay in your wallet.

composer.title: New proposal
composer.lead: You need voting power above the threshold.

templates.fundRewards: Fund the reward pool from the treasury

composer.spdxHint: Only licenses that allow redistribution. Commons Clause, non-commercial, AGPL and the like cannot be integrated.
composer.bodyPlaceholder: Why this, and what voters need to know.
composer.done: Proposal made. Voting opens after the voting delay.

badge.verifiedTitle: The content hash your browser computed for the source on this page matches the version registered on chain
badge.mismatchTitle: The source on this page does not match the content hash registered on chain
badge.delistedTitle: A community moderator delisted this item

errors.rejected: You cancelled this in your wallet.

contract.InvalidSlug: Slugs can only use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.
contract.ContentAlreadyRegistered: The same content is already registered (each piece of content can be registered once).
contract.LicenseNotAllowed: This license is not on the allowlist.
contract.InvalidUpstream: Give both the upstream repository and the pinned commit, or neither.
contract.InvalidParent: A remix must start from an approved version of a listed item.
contract.NotMaintainer: Only the item's maintainer can submit new versions.
contract.NotPendingMaintainer: Maintainership was not handed to you.
contract.NoApprovedVersion: This item has no approved version; submit it again as a new item.
contract.VersionPending: The previous version is still in review.
contract.ConflictOfInterest: You have to sit this review out.
contract.ReviewPeriodNotOver: The review period is not over yet.
contract.ReviewHasVotes: Someone has voted, so it can no longer be withdrawn.
contract.InvalidParams: Invalid parameters (quorum at least 1, review period between 1 hour and 90 days).
contract.InsufficientRewardPool: The reward pool does not hold enough.
contract.ERC20InsufficientAllowance: The bond allowance is too low.
contract.AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount: Your address does not have this permission.
contract.AlreadyRegistered: This address already has a profile.
contract.NotRegistered: This address has no profile yet.
contract.InvalidHandle: Handles use 3–32 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.
contract.HandleTaken: Someone else already uses this handle.
contract.GovernorInsufficientProposerVotes: Your voting power is below the proposal threshold (remember to delegate first).
contract.GovernorAlreadyCastVote: You have already voted on this proposal.
contract.GovernorUnexpectedProposalState: The proposal's current state does not allow this.
contract.TimelockUnexpectedOperationState: The timelock delay is not over yet.

export.starterLead: A Vite + React + Tailwind v4 project that shows this effect full screen with the values you tuned, plus the matching agent skill. Unzip, run npm install and npm run dev.
export.shadcnTitle: Install into an existing project with shadcn
export.shadcnLead: Run it in a project that already uses shadcn/ui. The component goes to components/motif/ and the shared motif-runtime to lib/.
export.manualLead: Copy the component file (with your values baked in) into your project, and put the shared hooks in src/lib/motif-runtime.ts.

skill.title: Hand this effect to your agent
skill.lead: A skill is a manual written for agents: when to use the effect, how to install it, the values you tuned and the rules not to break. Put it in your project and Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents can build the same effect there.
